name: SIFT Flow Scene Parsing Benchmark
description: The SIFT Flow dataset consists of 2,688 outdoor images annotated with pixel-level semantic category labels across 33 semantic classes (such as sky, building, tree, road, car, sea, etc.) and geometric context classes, aligned via dense SIFT Flow correspondence.
